import os, time, numpy as np, xarray as xr, pandas as pd
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
D="/data/icsa2027_data_20261101T090944Z/s1z"
dates=pd.date_range("1991-12-27","2003-01-05").tolist()+pd.date_range("2020-06-01","2020-08-31").tolist()
li0,li1,lo0,lo1=45,105,463,523
def load(d):
    p=f"{D}/sst_{d:%Y%m%d}.nc"
    with xr.open_dataset(p,engine="h5netcdf") as x:
        t=pd.Timestamp(x.time.values[0])
        assert t==pd.Timestamp(d), (t,d)
        return x.analysed_sst.values[0,li0:li1,lo0:lo1].astype(np.float64)
t0=time.time()
with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as ex: arrs=list(ex.map(load,dates))
A=np.stack(arrs); print(A.shape, time.time()-t0)
np.savez("/tmp/sst_sub.npz", A=A, dates=np.array([str(d.date()) for d in dates]))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
z=np.load("/tmp/sst_sub.npz"); A=z["A"]; dts=pd.to_datetime(z["dates"])
# doy by month/day, leap-year convention
ref=pd.date_range("2000-01-01","2000-12-31")
doy_of_md={(d.month,d.day):i+1 for i,d in enumerate(ref)}
doy_all=np.array([doy_of_md[(d.month,d.day)] for d in dts])
# baseline dates
bstart,bend=pd.Timestamp("1992-01-01"),pd.Timestamp("2002-12-31")
ext_start,ext_end=pd.Timestamp("1991-12-27"),pd.Timestamp("2003-01-05")
idx_of={d:i for i,d in enumerate(dts)}
ny,nx=A.shape[1:]
thr=np.full((367,ny,nx),np.nan); clim=np.full((367,ny,nx),np.nan)
base_dates=pd.date_range(bstart,bend)
for d in range(1,367):
    if d==60: continue
    bs=[b for b in base_dates if doy_of_md[(b.month,b.day)]==d]
    xs=set()
    for b in bs:
        for k in range(-5,6):
            x=b+pd.Timedelta(days=k)
            if ext_start<=x<=ext_end: xs.add(x)
    ii=[idx_of[x] for x in sorted(xs)]
    P=A[ii]  # pool, shape n,ny,nx
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        thr[d]=np.nanquantile(P,0.9,axis=0,method="hazen")
        clim[d]=np.nanmean(P,axis=0)
thr[60]=(thr[59]+thr[61])/2; clim[60]=(clim[59]+clim[61])/2
def smooth(arr):  # arr indexed 1..366 at [1..366]
    v=arr[1:367]  # 366,...
    out=np.empty_like(v)
    for i in range(366):
        ids=[(i+k)%366 for k in range(-15,16)]
        out[i]=np.mean(v[ids],axis=0)
    return out
T=smooth(thr); C=smooth(clim)  # index i -> doy i+1
print(np.isnan(T).sum(), np.isnan(C).sum(), T[150,0,0], C[150,0,0])

tgt=(dts>=pd.Timestamp("2020-06-01"))&(dts<=pd.Timestamp("2020-08-31"))
sea=np.isfinite(A[tgt]).all(axis=0)
print("sea cells",sea.sum(), "of",sea.size)
print("raw thr NaN per cell in sea:", np.isnan(thr[1:367][:,sea]).sum(), "clim:",np.isnan(clim[1:367][:,sea]).sum())
print("smoothed T NaN in sea:", np.isnan(T[:,sea]).sum(), "C:", np.isnan(C[:,sea]).sum())
print("cell-days with NaN in raw pool, sea:", np.isnan(thr[1:367][:,sea]).sum())
bad=np.isnan(A[:, :, :]).any(axis=0); print("cells with any NaN in full data:", bad.sum())
# which sea cells have NaN baseline? count finite values in baseline
fin=np.isfinite(A).sum(axis=0); print(fin[sea].min(), fin[~sea].max() if (~sea).any() else None)

ext_start,ext_end=pd.Timestamp("1991-12-27"),pd.Timestamp("2003-01-05")
bstart,bend=pd.Timestamp("1992-01-01"),pd.Timestamp("2002-12-31")
idx_of={d:i for i,d in enumerate(dts)}
ny,nx=A.shape[1:]
thr=np.full((367,ny,nx),np.nan); clim=np.full((367,ny,nx),np.nan)
base_dates=pd.date_range(bstart,bend)
for d in range(1,367):
    if d==60: continue
    bs=[b for b in base_dates if doy_of_md[(b.month,b.day)]==d]
    xs=set()
    for b in bs:
        for k in range(-5,6):
            x=b+pd.Timedelta(days=k)
            if ext_start<=x<=ext_end: xs.add(x)
    ii=[idx_of[x] for x in sorted(xs)]
    P=A[ii]
    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        thr[d]=np.nanquantile(P,0.9,axis=0,method="hazen")

run = r'''
exec(open("/tmp/base.py").read())
import xarray as xr
def smooth(arr):
    v=arr[1:367]
    out=np.empty_like(v)
    for i in range(366):
        ids=[(i+k)%366 for k in range(-15,16)]
        out[i]=np.mean(v[ids],axis=0)
    return out
T=smooth(thr); C=smooth(clim)
tgt=(dts>=pd.Timestamp("2020-06-01"))&(dts<=pd.Timestamp("2020-08-31"))
S=A[tgt]; td=dts[tgt]; dd=doy_all[tgt]
sea=np.isfinite(S).all(axis=0)
ntd,ny,nx=S.shape
thr_t=T[dd-1]   # per target day, cell
hot=(S>=thr_t)&sea[None]
mhw=np.zeros((ntd,ny,nx),dtype=np.uint8)
for j in range(ny):
    for i in range(nx):
        if not sea[j,i]: continue
        h=hot[:,j,i]
        # runs of hot
        segs=[]; t=0
        while t<ntd:
            if h[t]:
                s=t
                while t<ntd and h[t]: t+=1
                if t-s>=5: segs.append([s,t-1])
            else: t+=1
        # join segments separated by 1 or 2 non-hot days
        merged=[]
        for sg in segs:
            if merged and (sg[0]-merged[-1][1]-1) in (1,2):
                merged[-1][1]=sg[1]
            else: merged.append(list(sg))
        for s,e in merged: mhw[s:e+1,j,i]=1
active=mhw.reshape(ntd,-1).any(axis=1)
events=[]; t=0
while t<ntd:
    if active[t]:
        s=t
        while t<ntd and active[t]: t+=1
        events.append({"onset":str(td[s].date()),"end":str(td[t-1].date())})
    else: t+=1
print("sea cells",sea.sum(),"active days",active.sum(),"events",events)
print("cells with any MHW", (mhw.sum(axis=0)>0).sum(), "mhw cell-days", mhw.sum())
# coords from a file
with xr.open_dataset(f"{D}/sst_20200615.nc",engine="h5netcdf") as x:
    lat=x.latitude.values[45:105]; lon=x.longitude.values[463:523]
out=xr.Dataset({"mhw":(("time","lat","lon"),mhw)},
    coords={"time":td.values,"lat":lat,"lon":lon})
os.makedirs("/tmp/output",exist_ok=True)
out.to_netcdf("/tmp/output/mhw_mask.nc")
rep={"region":{"lat_min":54.39,"lat_max":55.59,"lon_min":18.25,"lon_max":19.45},
     "baseline_analysed":{"start":"1992-01-01","end":"2002-12-31"},
     "target_analysed":{"start":"2020-06-01","end":"2020-08-31"},
     "events":events,"complete":True,
     "caveats":"Baseline windows used days 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 as specified. Land/non-sea cells (any NaN in target period) are 0. Per-cell gap-joining done in a single pass."}
json.dump(rep,open("/tmp/output/report.json","w"),indent=2)
print("written")
'''
